newsitem.title: GERMANY: Swisscargo to open German telephone unit.
newsitem.headline: Swisscargo to open German telephone unit.

text.p: Swisscargo, the cargo arm of Swissair, said it will open a centralised Germany telephone sales unit at Frankfurt airport on May 1.
The airline's general cargo manager Germany, Ulf Steinmann, said the 11-person unit would allow remaining Swisscargo sales staff more time for direct client contacts.
"We want to centralise rates enquiries, paperwork, client contracts, reservations and capacity management," Steinmann told Reuters in an interview.
"The result is that in all Germany we will have one Swisscargo sales representative at each station who will be freed from administration," he added.
The airline felt it needed more presence at Frankfurt due to the "very strong concentration" of the German air cargo community in Frankfurt, he pointed out.
Swisscargo representatives would be active in Frankfurt, Hamburg, Berlin, Cologne, Duesseldorf, Munich and Stuttgart, Steinmann said.
The telephone sales unit could in time become a Swisscargo Service Line similar to the passenger sales Service Line unit run by Swissair, Sabena and Austrian Airlines.
